objective: Make critique/revision evidence-sensitive by freezing the original task contract, while preserving genuine updates when evidence, authority, scope or user intent materially changes.

roles_before.artifact: BOOTSTRAP.md -> CURRENT.md -> exact owner -> live owner
explicit user request plus existing decision-identity/outcome rules
re-evaluation against evidence and original request

role_dispositions.destination: No reduction in consequential verification or planning.
Explicit deliverable/scope/criterion/horizon are frozen as the task contract during critique unless the user or new evidence materially changes them.
Revision tracks task/evidence deltas rather than user confidence; genuine evidence changes still require revision.
Existing execute-before-final and resolved-action-state rules remain unchanged.
main unchanged until behavioral and CI gates pass.

capability_probes.assertion: The same fresh-chat sequence must HOLD under unsupported challenge, REVISE after explicit scope/evidence change, then HOLD under renewed unsupported challenge.
Concrete factual/scope/provenance errors must still be corrected when found.
Ron OS current-state routing and NOW/TARGET distinctions remain intact.
No regression to stopping at diagnosis while safe assistant-owned work remains.

tests.command: Run tests/self-correction-task-contract-v4-switch.md in isolated fresh chats for control and candidate; score only afterward with tests/self-correction-task-contract-v4-key.md.
tests.expected: 8/8 and zero hard fails; candidate must not merely be more stubborn.

tests.command: python tests/architecture_change_guard.py && python tests/architecture_change_guard_selftest.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard_selftest.py

verification.promotion_gate: Do not modify main or Custom Instructions until matched fresh-chat control/candidate switch runs pass and regression checks remain clean.
